events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.94)
events.body: The driver cancelled this RydeX trip and the platform charged a $6.61 no-show fee, so the dispute enters the cancellation policy through NS-0 (cancelled_by = driver claiming rider no-show) [F3][F6][NS-0]. Under NS-1 the fee stands only if all three conditions hold: an "I'm Here" tap, GPS placing the driver at the pickup point at the moment of the tap, and more than 3 minutes of waiting inside the pickup radius [NS-1]. The trace settles (i) as met but (ii) and (iii) as failed [F5][F1]. The GPS record shows the driver's closest approach to the pickup point was 288 m, never within 200 m, and he was 350 m away at 08:48:15 when he tapped "I'm Here", staying inside the radius for 0 s afterwards, while stationary 350 m away from 08:47:55 to 08:51:55 [F1][F2][F5]. The platform also never recorded him at the pickup point [F4]. System records (gps / timeline) override the driver's contrary assertion that he was at the pickup and waited there, which is a post-trip claim and not consent or evidence of arrival [F12]. Since NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both fail, NS-2 applies in full: the $6.61 fee is refunded to the rider, i.e. the full cancellation fee charged on record [F6][NS-2]. The chat does not rescue the fee: the driver announced arrival at 08:48 which the GPS contradicts, the rider replied at 08:49 that she was at the pickup point and saw no car (consistent with the GPS), and the driver's 08:51 "waited more than 3 min, cancelling" message simply precedes the cancellation [F8][F9][F10][F3]. I read every chat line, the complaint and the driver's statement: no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears — the messages are a factual arrival/no-arrival exchange — so the safety screen is none, and no SAFE-1 / SAFE-2 escalation is triggered [F8][F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. Finally, the trace flags a false arrival tap: the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him 350 m from the pickup point, which NS-2 treats as abuse of the waiting/cancellation button and calls for an account flag [F5][F1][NS-2]. That flag is issued as a structured account action in addition to the refund; the refund itself flows from NS-2 and FARE-1 (the $6.61 is not a valid charge), and per NS-7 it is paid as a Ryde voucher [FARE-1][NS-7].
